cells.remarks: [vernacular text] 355 Translation. In the name of God, the merciful and compassionate. This delightful garden, a twin of the garden of Paradise. Its founder is the world-conquering (Jahangir) Khan, with dignity and majesty. Its verdure is like enamel; its flowers like silver and gold. Hence wisdom composed the chronograph : "Enamelled garden." 1104 A. H. — 1692 A. D.¹

Translation.
In the name of God, the merciful and compassionate.
This delightful garden, a twin of the garden of Paradise.
Its founder is the world-conquering (Jahangir) Khan, with dignity and
majesty.
Its verdure is like enamel; its flowers like silver and gold.
Hence wisdom composed the chronograph : "Enamelled garden."
